difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if Y is a Nagata algebraic space over a scheme S and f : X -> Y is locally of finite type, then X is Nagata (source lines 5238-5243). The proof takes surjective etale presentations V -> Y and U -> X x_Y V with U, V schemes: Nagata-ness of Y makes V a Nagata scheme, local finite typeness of f makes U -> V locally of finite type, and the scheme statement for a locally finite type morphism over a Nagata base gives that the scheme over the cover is Nagata; Nagata-ness of X then follows by definition.
